page0.text:
This might be my last time.
Ten years ago...
I was the lone survivor of the terrible fire, and if I'm going to succeed Kiritsugu, who destroyed the Holy Grail, I should at least report that to him.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-06:page0:1

page1.text: I'll take on your dream, old man.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-06:page1:1

page2.text:
A young boy said those words, so long ago.
Back then, I didn't even understand the feelings the man left behind, nor did I understand what I wanted to achieve.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-06:page2:1

page3.text:
After ten years...
...the thing I kept striving for...
...the reason I was the only survivor...is about to reveal itself.
"Thanks for everything. I'm going to go now...Dad."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-06:page3:1

page4.text:
My fear and hesitation fade.
We have no chance of winning.
But if I'm going to call myself Shirou Emiya, I need to go into this with my head held high.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-06:page4:1
